questions.prompt: Directions: For this part, you are allowed 30 minutes to write an essay on the importance of having a sense of family responsibility. You should write at least 150 words but no more than 200 words.
questions.correctAnswer:
Having a sense of family responsibility means recognizing that a family depends on the care and effort of all its members. Love becomes more reliable when it is expressed through everyday actions and thoughtful decisions.

For young people, responsibility includes sharing household tasks and staying aware of their parents' needs. A student living away from home can make regular calls, listen carefully and help solve practical difficulties during visits. These actions are small, but they prevent family affection from becoming merely a pleasant idea. Parents also have responsibilities: they should provide support, respect their children's growing independence and avoid placing unrealistic expectations on them. When duties are shared fairly, family members are better able to face illness, financial pressure or other difficulties together. A supportive home then becomes a source of confidence rather than constant tension.

Family responsibility should therefore be taught through example and discussion. Each person can contribute according to their age and ability. By combining care with respect, we create strong family relationships and carry these habits into the wider community.

questions.prompt: It is quite easy for one to take in the recommended amount of protein.
questions.passage:
How Much Protein Do You Really Need?

A) The marketing is enticing: Get stronger muscles and healthier bodies with minimal effort by adding protein powder to your morning shake or juice drink. Or grab a protein bar at lunch or for a quick snack. Today, you can find protein supplements everywhere—online or at the pharmacy, grocery store or health food store. They come in powders, pills and bars. The most powerful influences occur during early childhood and include both what happened to you directly, and what those around you did and said in your presence. About that same time and throughout adulthood, the information you receive, especially when ideas are repeated in association with goals and achievements you find attractive, also refines your attitudes.
